chapter_title_en: The Tristar Crescent Secret and the Lineage of Power
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era 576: Tristar Crescent Secret, Daofather Disciples Revealed
chapter_meta_description: Patriarch Subhuti reveals the layered space of Tristar Crescent, accepts Red Snow as a disciple, and introduces his four Daofather-class fighters: a woodcutter, a monk, a monkey, and a tiger.
og_description: Ji Ning learns his master's secret hideout is in a different dimension and gets the full roster of his terrifyingly powerful senior brothers.
twitter_title: Time for a Cosmic Family Reunion!
twitter_description: The lore drops thicken! Patriarch Subhuti explains his secret world and unveils his four Daofather disciples, including a sleeping Jidian and Sun Wukong himself!

lore_anchors.definition: The secret personal world of Patriarch Subhuti, existing in a separate layer of space from the rest of the Three Realms, making it nearly impossible for other Daofathers to find.
A high-level Ki Refining cultivation stage, representing a perfected immortal who has refined their energy core to pure yang, granting immense power.
A high-level Fiendgod Body Refining realm, representing a perfected divine body and immense physical power.
In the Desolate Era system, this is the Daoist translation for a high-level divine figure who has mastered a Grand Dao, analogous to a Daofather in Ki Refining.
A cultivator who has fully mastered a Grand Dao, representing the pinnacle of the Three Realms' hierarchy.
The second disciple of Patriarch Subhuti, a mad monk inspired by the folk hero Ji Gong, who guards the Three Realms Palace and represents the union of Buddhist and Daoist methods.
The legendary Monkey King, the sixth disciple of Subhuti, a powerful Elder God known for his immense combat prowess and his creation of the Flowerfruit Mountain world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How is the Tristar Crescent Major World hidden?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It exists in a different layer of space, like a filling inside a multi-layered cake, while all other methods of travel only work on the surface.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who are the four Daofather disciples of Patriarch Subhuti?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The first (the woodcutter), the second (Jidian), the sixth (Sun Wukong), and the twelfth (Black Tiger).

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't the Tristar Crescent Major World avoid the coming calamity?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Patriarch Subhuti senses through fate that no living being in the Three Realms can escape the coming conflict.
